meta.description: Bends paths down under their weight, more toward the tip. Every segment keeps its length, so a path droops without stretching.

plant.description: The paths to bend. Only the deepest level bends (see depth), the others are passed on.

strength.description: How far a path droops: its tip turns by strength × 90° from its own direction toward the ground and on past it, so 0.5 turns it by 45°, 1 an upright tip to horizontal and 2 into a hook that points down. A negative value bends it up. Read along the path, alpha goes from the base (0) to the tip (1), and anew for every path, so time or path_info grown into a curve lets a bud nod and straighten up as it opens.

elasticity.description: How rigid the stem is. 0 = rope (uniform droop), 1 = stiff rod (only the tip bends).

depth.description: On which layers of paths to work, counted from the deepest. 1 bends only the deepest paths, higher values reach down to the trunk. Paths always follow the paths they grow on, also on layers that are not bent.
